nativeEventIdentity.note: Native identity diagnostic only; Concord match is informational, not a universal event requirement.

detection.reason: No unique league + native ID + Australian event date + track + car match.

championship.note: Requires league/native event identity, Australian schedule date, track and car; no weekday assumptions.

sessionCapture.note: No safely detected KHR series, so no result was captured.

championshipNativeReview.note: Native subsession registry evidence only. Existing day/track/car detector and all scoring/persistence remain unchanged.

yotaEOL.rule: Previous round Feature winner starts EOL at the immediately following round only; absence expires obligation.
yotaEOL.note: Yota series not positively identified; track changes must not force a series match.

fallFestRegistry.note: Historical reference does not override the existing championship detector.

nativeHistoricalResults.note: Candidate only. No event identity, live completion or stability validation; do not publish as verified finish.

nativeCompletionSafety.note: Diagnostic eligibility only; no publication. Event identity must be validated against native weekend/subsession before automatic finishing is enabled.

nativeClassificationStability.note: Observation only. Stable classification is not proof of final live session or valid league identity; existing 13.1I safeguards unchanged.

nativeFinalSessionEvidence.note: Compare replay and session clocks at different replay positions; no automatic live/replay verdict or publication.

nativeFeatureVerificationPreview.note: Combines read-only Feature evidence. No live/replay provenance proof; cannot authorize publishing.

eolGridPreview.note: Read-only expected EOL grid from previous-round official canonical archive.

eolBroadcastStats.note: Movers/droppers require an event-matched, complete, confirmed finishing order; SDK current positions are not assumed to be results.

unifiedArchive.note: Read-only unified archive discovery. No classification, scoring, capture or live behaviour changed.

nativeReconciliationLive.note: Native results availability is not archive acceptance. Only archivedDecision can confirm applied reconciliation.

legacyDiagnostics.note: Files are diagnostic evidence, not unique races. No legacy rows are added.
